title: DSC Dataset: PMDCo (Simplified Input)
description: Simplified input for a DSC heat-flow dataset KItem. Provide the dataset name, optional scalar results (onset/peak temperature, enthalpy, etc.), and column specs from the parser. The transform converts this to full OO-LD (MeasurementDatum + ScalarValueSpecification nodes). Result type and unit labels are resolved to IRIs by the vocabulary service — no hardcoded unit codes needed.

dataset_name.title: Dataset Name
dataset_name.description: Human-readable name for this DSC dataset.

dataset_id.title: Dataset ID
dataset_id.description: Optional IRI slug. Auto-derived from dataset_name if omitted.

format.title: File Format
format.description: Instrument file format of the raw data.

specimen_iri.title: Specimen IRI
specimen_iri.description: Optional IRI of the specimen. When provided, each quality individual gains a RO_0000080 (quality_of) link to the specimen, enabling SPARQL queries across specimens.

columns.title: Timeseries Column Specifications
columns.description: Semantic column specs from the parser — column name mapped to property IRI and QUDT unit IRI.

results.title: DSC Results
results.description: Scalar results from DSC analysis software (NETZSCH Proteus, TRIOS, STARe, etc.). Add one entry per extracted quantity. The 'unit' field must be a vocabulary label from the measurement-unit vocabulary service — it is resolved to a QUDT IRI automatically.

name.title: Result Name
name.description: Must match a label in the characterization-result vocabulary (ddsc: namespace).

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Vocabulary label from the measurement-unit vocabulary service. Resolved to QUDT IRI by the SDK — no hardcoded codes needed.
